title: Bernadette Roberts (official site, Blogspot)
description: Site set up during her lifetime (c. 2013) in her own first-person voice; lists her four books, the 'Recorded Talks' page selling the DVD set of the retreat 'The Essence of Christian Mysticism' (nine hours in four files, with handouts) and the talk 'A Passage Through Self'; states she considered the recorded retreat a prerequisite for The Real Christ. Maintainer after 2017 unknown (friends/family). Still online.

title: Bernadette's Friends (Blogspot)
description: Companion blog run by friends/students; 'Dear Friend' letter in her voice, 'Latest Book' note for The Real Christ, retreat listing for October 2013 at a Catholic retreat center in Fullerton CA (limited to 13 practising Christian contemplatives); carries the statement that there are NO authorized YouTube or online audio/video of Bernadette and that circulating recordings are unauthorized or falsely attributed. Also hosts an interview. Still online.

title: Wikipedia: Bernadette Roberts
description: English Wikipedia article (1931-2017, died in her sleep at home, Laguna Beach; earlier Santa Monica). Gives family: former husband Ron Danko (left 1976, annulment), four children Mark, Marcel, Melanie, Michaela 'Kayla', seven grandchildren; forty years of retreats with the Camaldolese monks at Big Sur; bibliography. Listed in Category:Carmelite mystics. Talk page not yet checked.

title: Wikidata Q4892809
description: Wikidata item; thin: 'American writer', born 1931, died 2017, religion Catholicism. No Wikiquote page found.

title: Internet Archive: Bernadette Roberts texts (roberts.* items)
description: archive.org holds: The Experience of No-Self (1982 scan, roberts.experience-of-no-self; also experienceofnose00robe lending copy), The Path to No-Self (roberts.path-to-no-self), What Is Self? PDF (roberts.what-is-self), and 'The Christian Contemplative Journey' (roberts.christian-contemplative-journey). Uploader unknown; likely unauthorized per the Friends blog notice.

title: SUNY Press author/book pages
description: State University of New York Press: The Experience of No-Self revised edition (1993, ISBN 9780791416945, 213 pp.) and The Path to No-Self new edition (1991). Current rights-holder for both early books.

title: Shambhala Publications (original editions)
description: Shambhala issued The Experience of No-Self (1982/1984, ISBNs 0877732892 / 0394726936 via Random House) and The Path to No-Self (1985, ISBN 0394729994). Now out of print at Shambhala; rights passed to SUNY. No current Shambhala author page found.

title: Sentient Publications: Bernadette Roberts collection
description: Sentient Publications (Boulder, publisher Connie Shaw) publishes What Is Self? (2005, ISBN 978-1-59181-026-1) and carries her other titles; The Real Christ (2012) publisher to confirm (likely self-published via her site).

title: Goodreads author page
description: Goodreads author 197971; The Experience of No-Self 4.26 avg, 187 ratings, 31 reviews.

title: SpiritualTeachers.org: Bernadette Roberts pages
description: Independent site; profile 'A Christian Mystic for Our Time', reprint of an interview, and a post of 28 Nov 2017 reporting she died in her sleep 'last night' (27 Nov 2017). Earliest online death notice found.

title: nonduality.com page (Jerry Katz)
description: Jerry Katz's Nonduality Salon page on Roberts, carrying excerpts/essay; Katz also included her in his anthology One: Essential Writings on Nonduality (Sentient, 2007). Page status unverified (possible Wayback-only).

title: Stephan Bodian interview reprint (Timeless Visions, Healing Voices)
description: The most-reprinted interview: Bodian for Yoga Journal Nov/Dec 1986, reprinted in Timeless Visions, Healing Voices (1991); copies also at awakeningtoreality.com (2007), spiritualteachers.org, twoplustwo forum.

title: Inner Explorations: 'Bernadette Roberts and the Experience of No-Self' (James Arraj)
description: Critical Thomist/Jungian reflection by James Arraj inviting discussion of her work.

title: Douglas Lockhart: 'Bernadette Roberts & the No-Self' (PDF)
description: Essay by author Douglas Lockhart on her no-self account.

title: Aquarian Catholic Spiritual Community: 'Bernadette Roberts Talks Available'
description: Page advertising availability of her recorded talks (DVD set).

title: Apple Podcasts episode: 'Bernadette Roberts: The Path to No-Self'
description: Third-party podcast episode discussing/reading her work (show id 1326902050).

title: Dharma Overground memorial thread 'Bernadette Roberts (1931–2017)'
description: Memorial thread; notes death 27 Nov 2017 at home after ALS diagnosis; debate on her no-self vs John of the Cross.

title: Shalom Place forum threads (Phil St. Romain)
description: Catholic contemplative forum run by Phil St. Romain; threads 'Bernadette Roberts on Buddhism, No-Ego, and No-Self' and 'A Passage through Self'.

title: Actualized.org forum threads
description: 'The Great Bernadette Roberts' and a 10/10 review thread of What Is Self?.

title: Julian Jaynes Society forum: 'Bernadette Roberts - What is Self?'
description: 2010 thread asking whether her later state resembles the bicameral mind.

title: Two Plus Two forum: 'Christian Mysticism: an interview with Bernadette Roberts'
description: Reposts the Bodian interview with discussion.

title: Unexplained Mysteries forum thread
description: Shares the nonduality.com essay with comments.

title: TAT Forum (TAT Foundation) 2006 retreat report
description: Participants Dan Garmat and Heidi Munn report on a May 2006 weekend retreat with Roberts.

title: Secondary profile pages (Sat Sangha Salon, Western Mystics, Enlightened People, Awakening to Reality)
description: Fan/aggregator pages reposting excerpts and the Bodian interview.

title: ContemplativeChristians.com Publishing
description: Imprint and order site named on her Blogspot books page ('to order go to contemplativechristians.com'); publisher of record for The Real Christ (Feb 2017 printing, ISBN 978-0692851159; earlier CreateSpace Oct 2016 ISBN 978-1539770466), The Christian Contemplative Journey: Essays on the Path (Dec 2017, ISBN 978-0692987216; Kindle Nov 2018) and Contemplative: Autobiography of the Early Years (2018 edition, ISBN 978-0692125175, first published 2014). Operator not named in search results; evidently her student circle/estate. Status (live vs Wayback) unverified.

title: Bernadette Roberts: Books page (Blogspot) — essay table of contents
description: Lists her books and the essays collected in The Christian Contemplative Journey: 'Cessation of Self', 'Nonduality', 'Mystical Theology and No-Self', 'Apatheia', 'The Eucharist, A Christian Path', 'What is Self? (research paper)', 'Ten Ox-herding Pictures', 'The Nature of Self'. Death announcement (27 Nov 2017, ALS diagnosed a year earlier; 'she asked us to notify her friends') is on the blog front page.

title: Internet Archive: later texts (The Real Christ; Contemplative autobiography)
description: Same uploader series (roberts.*): The Real Christ (2017 printing) and Contemplative: Autobiography of the Early Years PDFs.

title: 'What Is Self? — A Research Paper' PDF (written for Nini Praetorius)
description: Research paper whose preface says it was written at the request of Dr Nini Praetorius, University of Copenhagen; refers to the DVD 'A Passage Through Self' and the collection Essays on the Christian Spiritual Journey. Hosted by Sat Sangha Salon.

title: YouTube: 'The Path to No-Self: Beyond Unitive Consciousness with Bernadette Roberts' (Shawn Ellison)
description: Secondary video discussion of her teaching by Shawn Ellison; not a recording of Roberts.

title: Dancing Paradox podcast: 'Bernadette Roberts: The Path to No-Self'
description: c.14-minute excerpt of Roberts speaking on no-self, lifted from a YouTube upload; per the Friends blog any such audio is unauthorized.

title: Shalom Place: Jim Marion / Philip St. Romain dialogue (PDF)
description: Marion states he wrote about 'the American Catholic contemplative Bernadette Roberts' in Putting on the Mind of Christ (Hampton Roads 2000, foreword Ken Wilber); exchange on True Self vs Christ Self.

title: Blog essays on Roberts (Joseph Bray, No Mind's Land, Anamchara, IMERE)
description: Joseph Bray 2012 'What is self? A journey with...'; nomindsland.blogspot.com 2018 review; Carl McColman's anamchara.com 'The Nondual Writers of Footnote #45' listing her with Wilber; imere.org third-party account of her mystical experience.

title: New Camaldoli Hermitage (Big Sur) — audio archive
description: Camaldolese hermitage where she made retreats for forty years; its EngageWisdom audio archive is a lead for any talks she may have given there (none confirmed).

title: Goodreads quotes page / Citatis quotes
description: User-contributed quotations; stands in for a Wikiquote page (none exists).
